teaching.title: C/C++ Programming Trainer
teaching.organization: Talent IT & ICT Training Center, Rajshahi
teaching.description: Designed curriculum and delivered structured C/C++ programming courses to students over 3+ years. Covered foundational topics including data types, control structures, functions, pointers, and object-oriented programming. Guided students through hands-on problem-solving exercises and competitive programming preparation.

teaching.title: Workshop Facilitator - Game Development with Unity 3D
teaching.organization: The American Center, U.S. Embassy Dhaka
teaching.description: Facilitated a hands-on workshop introducing participants to game development fundamentals using the Unity 3D game engine. Covered core concepts including physics simulation, scripting in C#, and iterative design principles.

teaching.title: Engineering Mentor
teaching.description: Mentoring 5+ junior software engineers in backend architecture patterns, code review best practices, system design thinking, and professional development. Providing structured guidance on complex problem decomposition and production-grade code quality.

teaching.title: Science Outreach Volunteer
teaching.organization: SPSB (Society for the Popularization of Science, Bangladesh), Rajshahi Chapter
teaching.description: Organized and volunteered at science olympiads, astronomy workshops, science schools, and public lectures to promote scientific literacy among students and the general public. Contributed to outreach activities spanning 2 years and 9 months.

teaching.title: Science Writer & Campus Ambassador
teaching.description: Served as campus ambassador and contributed science articles to popular Bengali science magazines including 'Zero to Infinity', 'Pi Zero to Infinity', and 'Health Zero to Infinity'. Communicated scientific concepts to a broad public audience through accessible writing.
